messages:
olivia: Morning all — quick cut-window check. Train-13 overall green but canary-B is throwing 502s on long-seq requests.

olivia: Cherries: #4782 (kvcache bounds fix) merged to release-13, #4785 (quant hint) is up for review — needs one more +1. Backports: I opened release/13-rc branch and cherry-picked the debug logging change.

matt: saw the 502 spike at ~03:12 UTC, looks tied to reqs hitting sequence > 4096. Node gpu-12 showed OOM but then recovered. I can repro locally with the sample prompt.

junaid: pushed a quick patch (qa/hotfix/kv-guard) to try to avoid the OOM during decode. test run queued. Command I used to reproduce:
```bash
python reproduce.py --model redwood/bert-13 --seq_len 8192 --batch 1
```

sara: I can take #4785 review in ~30m. If junaid's patch is low-risk we can canary it behind the canary flag.

deploy-bot: [canary] deploy job #8273 started for release-13.canary-B (image: rwd/inference:v1.2.4-canary).

kai: CI is a bit slower this morning due to longer quant smoke. ETA for full test pass ~45m. I bumped concurrency on dedupe tests to reduce flake.

olivia: Blockers summary: canary-B 502s (investigate/rollback), one review needed for #4785, and quant smoke taking longer.

matt: I can repro and try the hotfix on a staging canary if junaid's tests look good. Ping me when it's up.

junaid: test passed on staging-3 (small sample), logs look clean. Pushed the branch to origin: https://github.com/redwood/repo/compare/hotfix/kv-guard

sara: reviewing #4785 now. lgtm on first pass except a minor docstring nit.

deploy-bot: [canary] canary-B reported 502 -> automatic rollback initiated to v1.2.3. See: https://deploys.redwood.internal/deploys/8273

olivia: OK — roll back happened. Plan: 1) land #4782/4785 into release-13, 2) merge junaid hotfix to staging, 3) re-run canary with stricter limits on seq_len, 4) aim for cut at 14:00 UTC if no new regressions.

kai: will prioritize the CI runs and free up one GPU node for the canary when ready.

matt: on it. I'll also post a short blurb in #incidents if we see customer impact.

sara: merged #4785 -> release-13. leaving a note about the docstring fix.

olivia: thanks everyone. If anything blocks the 14:00 cut call me directly. Otherwise I'll announce final gate 13:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
